entry.name: ChaosSpaceMarines/FallenBattleSisterDescription
entry.value: A six-model infantry squad of corrupted Battle Sisters. Armed with boltguns and close-combat weapons.

entry.name: ChaosSpaceMarines/FallenBattleSisterFlavor
entry.value: Once sworn to the Emperor, these Sisters have been cast into the service of Chaos. Their discipline and bolter drills remain, but their faith has turned to darker masters.

entry.name: ChaosSpaceMarines/FallenCanonessDescription
entry.value: A fallen Canoness hero armed with a power sword and combi-flamer. Her kills feed her resolve and that of nearby Chaos infantry, her litanies sharpen their blades, and she can step through the Warp to any explored tile.

entry.name: ChaosSpaceMarines/FallenCanonessFlavor
entry.value: Once a commander of the Adepta Sororitas, this Canoness now leads her warriors in the name of Chaos.
